confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, moved forward to July 2026 peak season. July 2026 values are modelled, not observed, and no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; hotel and hostel rates are least certain and vary widely by date. Cocktail and wine_glass were partly set from the beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. Local prices were converted at an assumed mid-2026 EUR/USD level. The RBA USD/AUD value comes from search-result summaries of the RBA table, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Basis is general knowledge of Florence's historic-centre tourist pricing, informed by similar Italian art cities such as Rome and Bologna; no named listings were consulted. A July peak-season uplift was applied to accommodation.
